parallels.note: For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit; nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.

translations.web: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit; but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.
translations.bsb: Likewise, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit.
translations.kjv: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
translations.asv: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but the corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
